tb21_profile.skill: Compile a complete, rule-exact algorithm (full chess move generation with castling, en passant, promotion, check legality) into a restricted computational substrate — an ordered list of re.sub rewrite rules — and verify it against a reference implementation
tb21_profile.domain: Python re semantics (backreferences, alternation, anchoring, ordered rewriting), FEN string encoding, game-rule state machines
tb21_profile.task_form: implement-from-spec at extreme depth: programmatically generate a large size-capped artifact that behaves as an interpreter, validated exhaustively against python-chess

TMax-15K.reason: Implements a string-rewriting VM's missing opcodes and is fuzzed against a reference implementation; same build-an-exact-string-machine crux.
Writes a bytecode interpreter from a recovered spec that must match an oracle for any input byte sequence; same exhaustive-equivalence bar.
Writes a stateful DSL interpreter in a deliberately weak language (Bash) including a topological sort; implement-a-machine-under-constraint.
Reverse-engineers a binary's format and reimplements it 100% bit-exactly in pure Bash; total rule fidelity in a restricted substrate.
Must make a transformation exactly match a hidden oracle for arbitrary inputs, including the boundary case; the edge-case discipline castling/en-passant need.
Ports a state-machine parser across language versions while preserving exact behaviour; state-transition correctness is the crux.
Translates a Python state-machine log parser into pure Bash; re-encoding a state machine in a weaker substrate.
Ports a numerical state machine from Python 2 to pure Bash with identical behaviour; same transliterate-a-machine skill.
Repairs a stack-based virtual machine in C; requires holding the whole instruction-semantics model in head, genre is debug not build.
Fixes and builds an expression interpreter with an AST depth limit; parser/evaluator semantics under a hard resource cap.

Recursive-Task-Synthesis.reason: One regex with a backreference enforcing the same separator twice, then partitioning a dataset by match; exact regex semantics is the whole task.
Same backreference-regex construction, driven by a config file, with null for non-matches; regex-authoring precision transfers directly.
Loads a regex pattern from JSON and reports exec() results per input; the same pattern-plus-data-file plumbing as re.json.
Single-regex phone validator with optional parentheses and repeated separator; must get alternation and grouping exactly right.
Another single-regex acceptance-set task; reinforces regex construction but has no state machine to build.
Generates regexes with rgxg and validates a log with them; regex-as-generated-artifact, which is what re.json is.
Produces a set of regex artifacts for a fixed sentence; machine-generated regex output, shallow.
Compiles and differentially runs two Brainfuck interpreters; esoteric-interpreter domain, but the work is static-analysis flags.
Email regex that must accept and reject an exact given set; acceptance-set reasoning, tiny scope.
Near-duplicate email-regex task; included because this corpus has nothing closer to building a machine out of regexes.

TerminalWorld-Seeds-Clean.reason: Emulates a dan32 binary from a disk image with a hand-written interrupt handler; executing a machine you have to model yourself.
Generates several regular expressions with rgxg and orders their output exactly; regex-as-artifact with strict ordering.
Drives a custom expression interpreter and captures exact evaluation output; interpreter semantics, no implementation.
Extracts Hangul runs with a character-class regex; requires getting a Unicode regex exactly right, small scope.
Proves commutativity in Agda via an interactive tactic REPL; total-correctness-over-all-cases mindset, wrong substrate.
Drives a prefix-notation calculator and reproduces its exact numeric results; evaluator semantics, shallow.
Encodes a constraint puzzle declaratively in Prolog; expressing rules in a non-imperative substrate, tiny.
Builds and runs a finite-state-machine leader-election simulation; FSM state reasoning, mostly a build task.
Reproduces byte-exact output a system would emit; exact-output-equivalence discipline only.
Computes inode indirection levels by rule from block and pointer sizes; pure rule evaluation, no machine construction.

SWE-Smith-Seeds-Clean.reason: Repairs re_find/re_all-style regex helpers; forces exact reasoning about group capture and match semantics in Python re.
A match() rewritten as substring containment instead of pattern matching; exactly the regex-vs-literal semantics distinction re.json depends on.
Nested-structure parsing broken in a parser-combinator library; grammar composition reasoning close to composing rewrite rules.
Matches succeed and fail in inverted cases; debugging acceptance-set errors in a matching engine.
Grammar normalizer-issue machinery in a Python parser; rule-driven traversal correctness.
Splitting SQL scripts with DECLARE CURSOR and BEGIN blocks; ordered-token state machine with nesting, like castling-rights bookkeeping.
Tokenization breaking on punctuation; lexical-rule edge cases, statistical tagger rather than deterministic rules.
Parser initialisation of a regex map for datetime formats; regex-table-driven parsing, shallow fix.
Array-indexing syntax mis-parsed; small grammar-rule correction.
Parse results returned in reverse order; ordering semantics of a matching engine, narrow.

SWE-Rebench-Tasks-Clean.reason: Empty-pattern fast path ignores fullmatch; demands precise Python re anchoring semantics, the exact trap re.json rules fall into.
Generating strings that satisfy re.match/fullmatch filters; reasoning backwards from a regex to its language, as re.json requires.
Finite-state-machine game players fail to reset state between matches; game-rule state bookkeeping analogous to castling rights.
Multiple regex route patterns mix up captured parameters; ordered pattern matching with capture groups colliding.
Converter regex containing a group changes matching isolation; subtle grouping semantics inside a larger composed pattern.
Grammar caching/loading failure in a parser generator; grammar-as-data machinery, the bug is serialisation not semantics.
Regex over-escaping in a pattern filter; escaping correctness, which directly bites when generating regex strings into JSON.
Regex pattern filter not matching what the user expects; acceptance-set debugging, small.
AllowedPattern regular-expression validation rejected valid patterns; regex-as-config-value handling.
Template tokenizer crashes on input; hand-written scanner correctness, weak link to regex rewriting.

final_top10.reason: Completes a string-rewriting VM whose output is fuzzed against a reference; building an exact string machine is the shared crux.
Implements an interpreter from a recovered spec that must equal an oracle on every input; same total-correctness standard.
Builds a stateful DSL interpreter in Bash, a deliberately weak substrate, including graph ordering; constraint-substrate implementation.
Bit-exact reimplementation of a binary's whole format in pure Bash; zero-tolerance rule fidelity under substrate limits.
Python re fullmatch/anchoring edge case in an empty-pattern fast path; precisely the regex semantics re.json rules hinge on.
Emulates a foreign architecture's binary with a hand-written handler; you must model and run a machine you did not design.
Single backreference regex enforcing a repeated separator, then exact accept/reject partitioning of a dataset.
Ports a state-machine parser while preserving exact behaviour; state-transition fidelity is the graded property.
Game-playing finite state machine keeps stale state across matches; the castling-rights class of state-bookkeeping bug.
Must satisfy a spec for every arbitrary input including the boundary case, fuzzed against a hidden oracle.

notes: No corpus contains a single chess task: 'chess' matches zero instructions across all 56k. So domain scores are driven by regex semantics and rule-engine/state-machine territory instead. The shortlists were almost pure boilerplate: the TMax shortlist surfaced generic log-parsing and py2-to-py3 chores, and every strong candidate here came from my own searches for interpreter/VM/bit-exact-oracle and regex-backreference tasks. Recursive-Task-Synthesis has no machine-building task at all; its top entries are the single-regex-with-backreference family, which at least teaches exact re semantics. TerminalWorld ranks 5-10 and SWE-Smith ranks 7-10 are filler at overall<=2. Note the two halves of this TB2.1 task pull apart: substrate skill (regex semantics) is best served by hypothesis/werkzeug/funcy, machine-construction skill by the TMax VM and interpreter tasks; no candidate covers both.
